title: A suite test plants an invented identifier in a lookup_eval-sourced pool row and asserts pool check's unstated-names warning
goal: _tools/test_bench.py holds a test, within the suite's tests ceiling, that plants an invented identifier in a fixture pool row built on a lookup_eval.csv case and asserts pool check prints the unstated-names warning with exit 0, and that a hand-written near-miss row naming an identifier absent from the fixture kb is not flagged (BG-fl4sg2py gate g2); today unstated_names and identifier_of have no test. Found by the SP-j2jn5ue4 review.
notes: Merged from BG-zopsjnou “pool check's unstated-names warning misses an invented identifier behind an inline flag, a group or a quantifier” at the 2026-10-12 draft triage: Repro exits 1: identifier_of (bench_pool.py:919) skips '(?i)Name'. It is the code half of ST-vwifqi4n, which tests the same unstated_names guard; fix and test belong in one item, and no committed row hits it. Its goal: identifier_of in _tools/bench_pool.py judges the identifier inside a check alternative written as (?i)Name, (Name|Other) or Name(?:s)?, so pool check warns of an invented name in those forms as it does of the bare one. No committed row hits it on 2026-10-12. Found by the SP-j2jn5ue4 review. Its repro: {"run": ["python3", "-c", "import sys,json;sys.path.insert(0,\"_tools\");import bench_pool as b;R=b.read_csv(b.PUBLIC_FILE);r=next(x for x in R if x[\"kind\"]==\"fact\" and x[\"source\"].startswith(\"lookup_eval.csv:\"));r[\"checks\"]=json.dumps([\"(?i)Invoke-ZzqxInventedDrift\"]);sys.exit(0 if b.unstated_names([r]) else 1)"]} Its touches: _tools/bench_pool.py, _tools/test_bench.py
